title: Service definitions and projections
explain: Services expose projections of the domain model to consumers. (Tier 1–2 simulation fidelity — verify production details in official SAP docs.)
analogy: Think of "Service definitions and projections" as a named building block you must explain under pressure.
whyItMatters: Without Service definitions and projections, you mis-diagnose incidents and make weak architecture choices.
commonMistakes: Memorizing the name of Service definitions and projections without a failure story
howToApply: Use Service definitions and projections explicitly in a design defense sentence
mnemonic: NAME IT TO TAME IT: Say “Service definitions and projections” + one failure mode out loud — if you can't, you don't own it yet. (Service → mechanism → failure)
useCases: Discount approval near S/4 — choose placement using Service definitions and projections without core mods.
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “Service definitions and projections” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Architecture review board: defend why you accepted residual risk around “Service definitions and projections”.
